features.title: Spatial consistency verification for pick postcondition
acceptance: Postcondition verifies held object XY position within CARRY_XY_TOL of gripper
Postcondition verifies held object z-height >= MIN_CARRY_Z (not resting)
All existing pick tests still pass (no regressions)
features.notes: Enhances F006 pick postcondition with spatial consistency checks. Detects false grasps where holding=True but object pose incompatible with gripper. Uses CARRY_XY_TOL=0.05m and MIN_CARRY_Z=0.05m. Robosuite compatibility verified theoretically (LIFTED_Z=0.08m > MIN_CARRY_Z); XY distance empirically unverified (requires live Robosuite).
